sentence: שלום, וברוכים הבאים לטאי צ'י 150. היום נתרגל ידיים כעננים. עומדים זקוף, הברכיים רכות, והנשימה איטית. כיסא או קיר בהישג יד.

designs.design_a: A warm, gentle woman in her early fifties speaking Israeli Hebrew. Soft, slightly low-pitched, velvety voice with a smile in it. Calm, reassuring and unhurried, like a kind yoga or tai chi teacher guiding beginners at home. Clear articulation, natural breathing, no breathiness, no theatrical drama.
designs.design_b: A serene, maternal Hebrew-speaking woman around forty-five, soft mid-range voice, very warm and pleasant, slow and patient delivery, like a meditation guide. Rounded, soothing tone, gentle confidence, never rushed, never sharp.
